name: @pipeworx/mcp-f1

tools.name: get_current_standings
tools.description: Check current F1 driver championship standings. Returns position, points, wins, driver name, and constructor for all drivers.

tools.name: get_race_results
tools.description: Get race results for a specific F1 grand prix. Provide season year and round number (e.g., 2024, round 5). Returns finishing position, driver, constructor, status, and points.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get the F1 season race calendar. Provide year (e.g., 2024). Returns all rounds with race name, circuit, location, and date.

tools.name: get_driver
tools.description: Look up F1 driver profile by ID. Returns name, car number, nationality, and date of birth.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-f1 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the f1 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
